description: This file defines the class One2OneBeanRelationship, which manages one-to-one bean relationships within the SuiteCRM framework. It extends the parent class One2MBeanRelationship and includes methods for adding relationships, updating links, and generating SQL join statements.

classes.name: One2OneBeanRelationship
classes.description: Represents a one-to-one relationship between beans, providing methods to add, update, and retrieve relationship data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the relationship with provided definition.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship between two beans, ensuring existing links are removed first.

methods.name: updateLinks
methods.description: Updates the relationship links on both beans to point to each other.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates the SQL JOIN clause for retrieving related beans, with support for table aliases and join types.
